name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Just one last thing you must do, soldier.

I've taken the liberty of putting Gor'tesh's head on a pike. Now all you have to do is take this head to the top of Dreadmaul Rock and stick it into the ground. Once you do that, watch as those cowardly ogres run for their lives! After you've had your fun, come back to me and I'll reward you for all of your hard work.

<Oralius seems to be losing touch with reality.>
narrative.objectives: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.
narrative.offerRewardText: Outstanding work, soldier! Simply amazing! Oh I'll get the medal of bravery for this, er, I mean you'll be rewarded handsomely for this!
narrative.requestItemsText: So? Did you paint any pictures of the event?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 52 to 53, 15,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Extinguish the Firegut
quests.objectiveText: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.

quests.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
quests.objectiveText: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock.

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
quests.objectiveText: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock.
